969-2105-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
969-2105-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2105-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2459-4247-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-4247-5006-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rograkh, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

275-2707-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

280-391-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-391-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-1940-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4556-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4556-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

147-4247-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1325-4050-5170-6132.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2033-3490-7075-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2033-3490-7075-7730.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3946-5449-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-7694.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7694.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7694.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

430-2743-3129-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-3129-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Primal Vigor.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

206-222-527-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

104-3490-4050-4210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-4210.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

104-3490-4659-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4659-6719.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3062-4772-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Doubling Season and Pir, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

549-1978-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
549-1978-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat

997-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

3678-5412-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5412-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

2921-3174-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

4508-4875-5880-6291.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4359-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2060-2946-6701-6797.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2946-6701-6797.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-6701-6797.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

104-3188-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3188-4186.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4215-6730.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

4222-6006-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

224-5033-6628.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-5033-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

719-1789-3967-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
719-1789-3967-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1018-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2713-4499-4685.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
When Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1575-1651-2557-4659.description:
Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Foods.

1462-1748-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1462-1748-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an additional creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Warehouse Tabby triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

1379-2178-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
1379-2178-4170.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing an creature, which is an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
When the creature dies, Fain triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token that is an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Repeat.

1235-2523-4365.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating two token copies of Ratadrabik and Mondrak with haste.
Put all Ratadrabik and Mondrak tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ratadrabik and Mondrak tokens die, causing a total of ten Ratadrabik triggers, six for the Mondrak tokens and four for the Ratadrabik tokens.
Resolve a Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) that are 2/2 Zombies with haste.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining Ratadrabik trigger that makes a Mondrak token.
Resolve a Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Ratadrabik equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) that are 2/2 Zombies with haste.

1479-2232-3875.notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonartifact land in hand.
You control a nontoken nonartifact land.
1479-2232-3875.description:
Play a nonartifact land.
Tireless Provisioner, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning another nonartifact land to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Food or Treasure token.
The Food or Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama, putting a nonartifact land onto the battlefield from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 3.

397-2034-4871.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Citizen, adding {C}{C}.
The Citizen dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1339-2178-4050-5028.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Arcanis the Omnipotent.
Arcanis the Omnipotent does not have summoning sickness.
1339-2178-4050-5028.description:
Activate Arcanis by tapping it, drawing three cards.
The Locust God triggers three times, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding one mana of any color.
Arcanis triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

876-4944.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting any creature you control except the creature that has Lightning Greaves attached.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's equip ability.
Repeat.

1996-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the blessed to flicker Brood Monitor.
Brood monitor's etb effect triggers creating 3 eldrazi scions.
Sacrifice the Eldrazi Scions to activate Emiel the blessed's ability.
Repeat.

391-3147-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3147-3525.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.

776-3690-3923.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
776-3690-3923.description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands you control to become 2/2 Elemental creatures that are still lands until end of turn.
Jeskai Ascendacy first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Activate all of your lands by tapping those, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Jeskai Ascendacy first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Repeat from step 5.
